label: Chapter you are filing under / The chapter of the Bankruptcy Code you are choosing to file under
value_needed: /Chapter 7 (decoded name; ticks p1 and p3 Chapter 7 widgets together)
why: Bound only by a "/Yes" constant that ticks nothing, so the petition never states its chapter. Every filing needs this.

label: Tell the court whether you have received a briefing about credit counseling (You must check one), Debtor 1
value_needed: asked: /1 (certificate), /2 (briefing, no certificate yet), /On (30-day temporary waiver), /4 (not required) + Check Box16A reason
why: The printed line says "You must check one... If you cannot do so, you are not eligible to file." Its only binding is a "/Yes" constant that matches no on-state.

label: How you will pay the fee
value_needed: asked: /Pay entirely | /Pay in installments | /Request fees waived
why: Every petition must choose a fee method. Choosing waiver must agree with Form 103B being generated (the app knows qualifies_for_fee_waiver, but the choice is the debtor's).

label: Are your debts primarily consumer debts?
value_needed: asked: /Yes or /No (Check Box19 for 16b if No)
why: Required, and it decides whether the means test (Form 122A) applies. Never bound; the Check Box16 constant was evidently meant for it.

label: Are you filing under Chapter 7? + Check Box20A: Do you estimate that ... funds will be available to distribute to unsecured creditors?
value_needed: Check Box20 /Yes; Check Box20A asked /No or /Yes
why: Required for a Chapter 7 petition; neither box is bound.

label: Why you are choosing this district to file for bankruptcy (Check one), Debtor 1
value_needed: asked: /Lived in this district or /Other (+ explanation lines)
why: Venue basis is required. The only binding is a "/Yes" constant, which matches neither on-state.

label: How many creditors do you estimate that you owe?
value_needed: one of /1-49 /50-99 /100-199 /200-999 ... (derivable from count of DebtInfo rows)

label: How much do you estimate your assets to be worth?
value_needed: range on-state, e.g. /0-50000 (derivable from total assets)
why: Required statistical item; unbound. The legacy _estimate_asset_range in form_101_generator.py is a placeholder that the PDF never uses.

label: How much do you estimate your liabilities to be?
value_needed: range on-state, e.g. /0-50000 (derivable from total debts)

pdf_field: Check Box8 / Check Box9 / Check Box10 / Check Box12 / Check Box14 / Check Box15
label: No/Yes answer boxes: prior bankruptcy in 8 years (9); pending case by spouse/partner/affiliate (10); rent residence (11, + Check Box11 eviction judgment); sole proprietor (12); Chapter 11 small business (13: "No. I am not filing under Chapter 11"); hazardous property (14)
value_needed: asked No/Yes per line; line 13 = /Not filing under Chapter 11 for a Chapter 7 case
why: The form says "Answer every question." The detail boxes under these lines are bound, but the No/Yes boxes themselves are not, so a petition with no prior cases, no business and no hazard leaves lines 9-14 blank.

pdf_field: Check Box24 / Check Box25 / Check Box26
label: Are you aware that filing for bankruptcy is a serious action...? / Are you aware that bankruptcy fraud is a serious crime...? / Did you pay or agree to pay someone who is not an attorney to help you fill out your bankruptcy forms?
why: DigniFi filers are self-represented, so page 9 is mandatory. The three acknowledgement boxes are unbound; only the preparer-name line is bound. Whether DigniFi counts as a paid non-attorney preparer (11 U.S.C. § 110) is a question for legal review.

label: Date (MM/DD/YYYY) under Signature of Debtor 1
why: The mandatory pro se signature block has no date binding (Debtor2.Date signed is also unbound, correctly for single filers).

label: Running header: Debtor 1 (First Name Middle Name Last Name)
why: The name must head every page so detached pages can be identified; never bound.

pdf_field: Debtor2.First name / Debtor2.Middle name_2 / Debtor2.Last name
label: Your full name, About Debtor 2 (Spouse Only in a Joint Case)
why: Joint filings only. The spouse's current name is bound to line 2 (other names) instead; Debtor2.Middle name_2 is source=skip and the other two are absent from the schema.
